---
description: Review the current page against the UniTools design rules
---
Review the open page(s) against `brain/02-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` and `brain/03-UX-RULES.md`.

Check, and list every violation with the file and line:
- anything on the "Never do this" list (gradients, shadows, glass, emoji, gradient text, generic hero, icon-in-circle card rows)
- colors, spacing, radii or fonts that are not design tokens
- marketing-style copy that breaks `brain/08-COPY-AND-LABELS.md`
- missing states (empty, loading, done, error)
- keyboard, focus, label and contrast problems
- anything that breaks at 360px width

Then fix the violations. Do not change behavior. Summarize what you changed in under 8 lines.
